physics_goals.quote: a hitherto unexplored pseudo-rapidity range of 7.2 < eta < 8.6 complementary to all the other experiments at the LHC, including FASER
physics_goals.value: Measure neutrinos produced in LHC pp collisions in an unexplored forward pseudo-rapidity range, complementary to FASER and the other LHC experiments

summary.plain: SND@LHC is a compact experiment in a disused CERN tunnel that catches neutrinos produced in LHC collisions, in a direction close to the beam that no other LHC experiment can see. It recorded collision data from 2022 until the LHC's current maintenance shutdown began in 2026.
summary.technical: Stand-alone forward neutrino/long-lived-particle detector in the TI18 tunnel, covering the pseudo-rapidity range 7.2 < eta < 8.6, complementary to FASER. Approved 17 March 2021; recorded LHC Run 3 pp-collision data from 2022 (arXiv:2305.09383) through June 2026; off since CERN's Long Shutdown 3 began.

unique_capabilities.quote: a hitherto unexplored pseudo-rapidity range of 7.2 < eta < 8.6
unique_capabilities.value: A compact, stand-alone detector covering a pseudo-rapidity range (7.2-8.6) not accessible to any other LHC experiment
